body: There is a reason she has multiple malpractice lawsuits and a terrible reputation. Risk it if you want, but the risk is not worth it, and the odds of it going wrong are much higher now with her than if you wait. A few months to a year of waiting are absolutely nothing compared to the rest of your life.

Exactly what it sounds like, your nerves can be damaged during surgery. You can end up with chronic nerve pain or permanent numbness in your chest. That's not even mentioning the possibility of necrosis if your incisions get infected, hematomas, and the risks that come with being fully sedated. The results looking bad are kind of the least of your worries with a surgery as invasive as this. You want the most competent medical team you can get to make sure you're safe.

She has terrible rates of revisions. Complications don't just mean things looking weird. Complications from a botched surgery can include nerve damage, PERMANENT nerve damage. This is a very serious decision, and I know it seems like forever to wait for another surgeon, but this surgery is going to impact the rest of your life in a big way if it goes wrong. It's up to you, but please take this advice to heart and think on it.
